notes: No CS department, Pratt/engineering-school or other computing-unit AI policy found by either coder, and course-layer documents were deferred; coded only the three university-layer documents (CTL policies guide, CTL home page, student recommendations PDF). Several units of the CTL policies page are quoted example policies and templates from other institutions (e.g. Gladd, Horowitz, Mollick, UC Santa Cruz, Sydow Campbell); Duke presents them as guidance, so they are coded as units of the Duke page and the resolution rationale notes that. The student PDF is non-binding. Reconciled: units from both coders aligned by source position; two sentences that contained two rules were split (the draft/final-paper sentence on the CTL home page, and the detector 'not definitive / starting point for a conversation' sentence).
